title: moenchia octandra
intro: Moenchia octandra, commonly known as False Dragonhead, is a species of flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Moenchia octandra include its antispasmodic and antiseptic properties, making it effective in relieving coughs, colds, and sore throats. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
